Grammy 2027 Nominations Announced, Raye Leads with 11 Nods

The nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards have been announced, with British singer Raye leading the field with 11 nods. Beyoncé received 100 nominations, and Rosalía also featured prominently. Notable omissions include Harry Styles and Sam Fender, while Madonna received significant attention. The Bollywood film "Dhurandhar The Revenge," starring Ranveer Singh, did not receive any nominations.
